privacyText: Wannan kayan aikin yana amfani da sabis na AI na ɓangare na uku don aiwatar da tambayoyin mai amfani. Ana share tattaunawa lokacin da kuka bar wannan shafin. Don Allah kar a ƙaddamar da bayanai masu mahimmanci ko na sirri.
aboutDescription: Yahya Qanie ne ya ƙera wannan kayan aiki, tare da tallafin Lena Slachmuijlder da Saji Prelis na Search for Common Ground; Murtaza Qanie ne ya jagoranci haɓakar fasaharsa. An ƙirƙire shi domin sauƙaƙa samun bayanai game da ajandar Matasa, Zaman Lafiya da Tsaro—wadda ta samo tushe daga Kudurin Kwamitin Tsaro na Majalisar Dinkin Duniya mai lamba 2250—da kuma ƙarfafa tafiyar YPS tsakanin ƙungiyoyi, masana da masu tsara manufofi.
aboutSourcesHeading: Menene tushen da yake amfani da shi
aboutSourcesDescription: Wannan kayan aiki an kafa shi ne a cikin tushen ilimi wanda ya haɗa da kudurori da tsare-tsare na Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya da ke samuwa a bainar jama'a, wallafe-wallafen Majalisar Dinkin Duniya, takaddun ƙungiyoyin yanki, tsare-tsaren ayyuka da dabaru na ƙasa, binciken ilimi, da wallafe-wallafe daga ƙungiyoyin jama'a da masu zaman kansu.
